detailed_descriptions_html.en:
SpellChain: A First-Person Spell-Crafting Fantasy RPG

Become the kingdom’s most dangerous troublemaker by mastering a dynamic spellcrafting system to create and shape your own spells. From your tower in the clouds you ponder your orb to travel between locations where you crash events and gatherings, cause chaos, and disrupt the realm’s daily life, all while growing stronger on your journey to slay the king.

Fight. Disrupt. Grow. Conquer.

Fight: Battle through waves of enemies in fast-paced, first-person magical combat

Disrupt: Crash events, destroy environments, and turn peaceful afternoons into chaos

Grow: Upgrade your wizard, unlock new abilities and expand your magical power

Conquer: Face powerful bosses each week as you push closer to defeating the king

Unique "Chain" Spellcrafting System

At the core of SpellChain is a flexible spellcrafting system that lets you create, modify and chain spells together. Its inspired by the spellcrafting and silliness of Magicka and the large scale destruction of Fictorum. Let your creativity take over in first-person on-the-fly combat and discover powerful and unpredictable spellchains to help you on your magical crusade.

  • Create and combine spells through a unique spellcrafting system

  • Fast-paced action combat with large scale magical destruction

  • Fight through waves of enemies using creative and explosive abilities

  • Experiment with different spell combinations to suit your playstyle

Evolve Your Power

Progress your wizard by unlocking new abilities, enhancing your magic, and customizing your build to suit your preferred approach to combat. Whether you focus on raw power, speed, or chaotic spell chains, your playstyle evolves as you grow stronger.

  • Level up your wizard and upgrade your magical abilities

  • Customize your build with gear, stat boosts, and enhancements

  • Purchase furniture and decorations to customize your wizard tower

  • Personalize your wizard’s look with hats, robes, and trinkets

A World That Changes Every Day

The kingdom is alive with events and you’re here to ruin them. Each day brings new opportunities for destruction, from weddings and birthday parties to public executions. Your actions won’t go unnoticed however, each week culminates in a powerful boss fight as the kingdom pushes back.

  • 20+ unique dynamic events that change throughout the week

  • Ever-changing locations that encourage replayability

  • Weekly boss fights, culminating in your path to face the King
